english.title: Holder of licence to operate PHV fail to comply with condition of licence to keep record of bookings invited / accepted
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been granted a licence by **(..SPECIFY COUNCIL..) under section 55 of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976 to operate private hire vehicles, without reasonable excuse, failed to keep a record in such form as prescribed by the council, enter therein, before the commencement of each journey, particulars, of each booking of a private hire vehicle invited or accepted by you and produce that record on request to an authorised council officer or a constable for inspection in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 56(2) and (5) and 76 of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
holder of a licence
granted by a district council under section 55
to operate a private hire vehicle
contravened a prescribed condition
attached to the licence by the district council
requiring entries to be made therein
before the commencement of each journey
of the particulars of every booking invited / accepted AND
whether the journey was accepted from the hirer OR
undertaken at the request of an operator
without reasonable excuse

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) A person to whom a licence with such a condition has been granted, will be expected to record details of every booking whether it has been invited / accepted or undertaken at the request of another operator.
(ii) It is important that such conditions of licence are complied with, as a district council may prescribe and produce such records when requested to do so by authorised officers of the council or a constable.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, having been granted a licence by **(..SPECIFY COUNCIL..) under section 55 of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976 to operate private hire vehicles, without reasonable excuse, failed to keep a record in such form as prescribed by the council, enter therein, before the commencement of each journey, particulars, of each booking of a private hire vehicle invited or accepted by you and produce that record on request to an authorised council officer or a constable for inspection in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..).
